headline: Mphasis and Coforge post strong Q2 results while Sonata Software struggles with seasonal headwinds
hook: Strong midcap IT quarter reveals clear divergence
summary: Mid-sized Indian IT companies reported mixed performance for the second quarter amid ongoing macroeconomic challenges. Mphasis and Coforge delivered strong revenue and profit growth, outperforming sector peers. Conversely, Sonata Software faced seasonal headwinds that weighed on its quarterly numbers. Indian retail investors holding IT stocks should note the selective outperformance within the midcap tech segment rather than a broad-based rally.

headline: Coforge partners with SpaceX Super Intelligence Network to deploy Grok AI
hook: Enterprise AI push via xAI partnership
summary: IT services firm Coforge has partnered with the SpaceX Super Intelligence Network to deploy Grok AI across enterprise clients. Under the deal, Coforge will use its Forward Deployed Engineering unit, Momentuum blue, to take Grok-powered solutions from development to production. The collaboration aims to accelerate enterprise adoption of advanced generative artificial intelligence models. Indian retail investors should note this strategic tie-up as it strengthens Coforge's high-value AI service offerings.
why_it_matters: New enterprise AI capabilities could strengthen Coforge's revenue growth.
